title: Pure Tenpai Dragon
summary: Tenpai Dragon and Sangen cards only, with generic Dragon Synchro Monsters and staples. The Tenpai Dragons are Level 3 and 4 FIRE Dragons that Synchro Summon during the Battle Phase, so the deck attacks, makes a Synchro mid-battle, and attacks again. Sangen Summoning searches a Tenpai Dragon and protects FIRE Dragons in Main Phase 1. Paidra adds or Sets a Sangen Spell/Trap. Chundra and Fadra summon more FIRE Dragons at the start of each Damage Step. Tenpai Dragon Genroku, the newest card, summons itself as a Tuner when added and tributes itself for another Tenpai Dragon. Sangenpai Transcendent Dragion forces their monsters to attack and stops their effects in the Battle Phase, and after three attacks the Sangenpai Synchros return from the GY. Chundra, Sangen Summoning and Sangen Kaimen are Limited.
